scope: Nineteen newly generated signature warrior skills completing the curated twenty-skill set; warrior_t01_c01 칼날 베기 keeps its approved snap-impact revision
commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D combat VFX overlay sprite sheet for AlarmQuest. Create exactly 16 chronological animation frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row, row-major sprite sheet. Every cell is an independent wide 361:160 combat viewport; final sheet 1444:640; Detailed hand-painted high-resolution 2D rendering; transparent RGBA; fixed camera and fixed scale; clean antialiased alpha; image-rendering auto; no pixel art. This batch contains selected signature warrior skills. Each skill must obey its own named spatial grammar and must not collapse into the same center-origin bloom used by another skill. Temporal contract: F01 is almost fully transparent. F02-F04 establish only the skill-specific anticipation at its declared start position. F05-F07 accelerate along the declared route without frame-to-frame redraw wobble. F08 is the clear primary contact. F09 is the unique maximum impact and adds only the declared surrounding release. F10 must immediately fall to at most 65% of F09 total energy; F11-F15 continuously decay without rebuilding; F16 is almost fully transparent. Reuse stable path geometry, contact position, angle, material thickness, and camera across frames. Animate reveal, translation along that path, deformation at contact, fragment movement, and alpha decay instead of redrawing a new unrelated silhouette in each cell. The effect must feel physical and warrior-like: forged steel pressure, compressed air, stone fracture, restrained sparks, and weight. Use layered foreground, midground, and background pieces with transparent corridors; do not fill the cell with an opaque wash. Power may grow with level, but F08 and F09 must remain readable at native 361x160 size. Peak shapes should occupy enough width and height for their stated grammar while preserving transparent negative space. Treat each cell as a separately clipped final viewport with no neighboring-frame residue. Render VFX only: no character, enemy, body, hands, complete weapon, scenery, ground plane, UI, text, labels, frame numbers, grid, borders, gutters, padding, or opaque background.

skills.name: 방패 돌파
skills.generationPrompt: Create SHIELD_RAM_BREAKLINE as a low-tier but decisive shield-pressure ram without drawing a literal shield. Start with a compact convex gunmetal pressure face at x=22%, y=58%. Drive it on one shallow rising line toward a fixed contact at x=58%, y=54%; F07 is already almost touching, F08 buckles one short vertical resistance slab, and F09 ejects three broad rectangular steel flakes toward the right edge plus one narrow backward air wake. Keep the ram face wide and blunt rather than pointed, with muted blue-gray air compression and two small amber contact sparks. Use one attack only; no circular shield emblem, no dome, no frontal magic barrier, and no center explosion.

skills.name: 철퇴 강타
skills.generationPrompt: Create COMPACT_MAUL_DROP as a compact vertical weight strike. Condense three uneven dark-steel pressure blocks above x=47%, y=14%, then drop them as one connected mass down a fixed slightly left-leaning axis. F08 compresses against the contact shelf at x=45%, y=72%; F09 forms a squat angular crush crown, two short horizontal fracture ledges, five pebble-sized iron chips, and a brief ochre dust puff. The silhouette must feel dense and blunt, never blade-like. Do not draw a mace head or handle, do not make a tall magical pillar, and do not use a symmetric circular ground ring.

skills.name: 공성 돌격
skills.generationPrompt: Create SIEGE_WEDGE_BREACH as a diagonal siege-pressure wedge. Begin with a short layered iron wedge just beyond the lower-left at x=10%, y=70%, and drive it through a fixed corridor to x=66%, y=52%. F05-F07 show three perspective ribs compressing behind the wedge; F08 punches through two offset wall-pressure plates; F09 keeps the wedge moving forward while the nearer plate shears toward the upper-right edge and the farther plate drops toward the lower-right edge. Use blackened iron, dusty tan, and restrained orange sparks. No battering-ram object, no castle scenery, no horizontal beam, no radial blast.

skills.name: 전투도끼 낙하
skills.generationPrompt: Create AXE_CRESCENT_DROP as one broad axe-pressure crescent falling from the upper-right toward a lower-middle contact. The immutable crescent route starts at x=72%, y=4%, bends through x=61%, y=38%, and lands at x=53%, y=77%. F06 shows only the upper hooked shoulder, F07 sweeps most of the crescent downward, F08 bites into a short jagged resistance facet, and F09 releases an asymmetric fan of four steel chips to the left with a narrow tan pressure fold to the right. Make the edge broad, chipped, and weighty rather than sword-thin. No literal axe or handle, no guillotine, no full moon arc, no symmetric wings.

skills.name: 광폭 연참
skills.generationPrompt: Create RAGGED_SIX_HIT_ROUTE as exactly six readable savage pressure cuts traveling through different off-center contacts without crossing into an X. Use a broken zigzag route: hit 1 upper-left, hit 2 left-middle, hit 3 lower-left, hit 4 lower-middle, hit 5 right-middle, and the largest hit 6 at x=75%, y=35% on F09. F03-F07 each introduce one short ivory-and-rust cut; F08 is the fifth strong cut; F09 is a short thick hooked sixth cut plus four prior low-alpha edge remnants and outward gunmetal chips. The route must migrate rather than bloom from the center. Palette: cold steel with restrained rusty red accents. No central star, no flower, no circular frenzy, no two long crossing diagonals, no extra seventh strike.

skills.name: 맹호 참격
skills.generationPrompt: Create TIGER_FANG_SHEAR as one simultaneous predatory shear, not multiple damage hits and not a literal tiger. Three uneven parallel pressure facets enter from the upper-right and rake toward the lower-left on one shared tangent; the middle ivory facet is dominant while the two amber-gray facets are shorter and broken. F08 makes all three facets bite the same armored contact plane at x=38%, y=67%; F09 peels that plane into triangular claw-like steel chips and one low smoky-gold air tear toward the left edge. Maintain imperfect spacing and unequal lengths so it feels animalistic without becoming a paw logo. No tiger face, stripes, claws as objects, orange magic, mirrored triple fan, or center explosion.

skills.name: 성문 깨기
skills.generationPrompt: Create GATEPOST_BUCKLE_CRUSH as a gatepost-breaking heavy impact. A tall narrow slate-steel compression post forms off-center at x=63% from y=8% to y=55%, then F06-F08 drives its upper mass down and inward against a fixed lower hinge at x=59%, y=74%. F09 shows the post buckling into two unequal angular sections, with one section falling right, the other kicking left, and a thick horizontal dust-pressure seam escaping along the bottom third. The impact should be architectural and brutal but contain no actual gate, building, hammer, or character. Avoid symmetry, circular rings, and a full-screen stone wall.

skills.name: 불굴 진격
skills.generationPrompt: Create UNYIELDING_RESISTANCE_RUN as a relentless dark-iron advance through resistance. Start with a low wedge at x=16%, y=68%. Along one rising route to x=71%, y=42%, place three thin resistance planes at different depths; F04 cracks the first, F06 bends the second, F08 breaches the third, and F09 carries the intact central pressure spine beyond the contact while fragments stream backward toward the left edge. No character, shield object, arrows, horizontal laser, centered blast, or retreating motion.

skills.name: 성벽 양단
skills.generationPrompt: Create OFF_AXIS_WALL_SHEAR_SIGNATURE as a large off-center wall-splitting cut. Two non-mirrored vertical stone-steel pressure faces occupy separate depths near the left and right edges while leaving a transparent diagonal corridor from x=34%, y=5% through x=60%, y=92%. A dense angular compression lobe begins above the upper-left edge and follows one short clockwise arc to a fixed right-side contact at x=70%, y=60%. skills.name: 산맥 붕괴타
skills.generationPrompt: Create RIDGECHAIN_COLLAPSE_STRIKE as a diagonal chain of mountain-pressure ridges collapsing from upper-left to lower-right. F09 is the unique collapse: front ridge slabs tilt and slide toward the lower-right edge, midground fragments fall into the opened fault, and a pale ochre dust sheet escapes upward-left while three transparent diagonal gaps remain. Use slate, umber, and ivory fracture light. No landscape illustration, no horizon, no avalanche filling the cell, no volcano, no symmetric earthquake ring.

skills.name: 철혈 관통
skills.generationPrompt: Create IRONBLOOD_PIERCING_LANE as one narrow high-pressure penetration lane. From three staggered entry streaks at the left edge, compress into a fixed gunmetal spear-tip-shaped pressure point at x=64%, y=51%; F07 is nearly at the point, F08 punctures a small armored plane, and F09 continues through to the right edge as a tight ivory core with dark-red stress seams and backward-flying iron splinters. skills.name: 군단 대돌파
